answer_1.quote: To evaluate the extent to which knowledge injection enables the medical foundation model to tackle unseen tasks, we compile five classification tasks (ECD, SP, PED, AD, and EBD) and three generation tasks (MR, SNC, and MS).
answer_1.outputs: answers to medical visual questions and clarifications of noisy signals

answer_2.quote: Accuracy for classification tasks and BLEU for generation tasks are used for visualization.
